items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: all the guys that I met on the road, it was Oil Hines and Fats Waller.

ctx.x: I was going to ask if you knew Steve Lewis. Yeah, he was a great piano player. I never got to know him.
He was a great piano player. Steve, Walter Pichon, all the guys that I met on the road, it was Oil Hines and Fats Waller.
